senses.sense_definition: A humiliating, embarrassing, or foolish mistake or failure.

examples.text: The administration suffered a major political <w>pratfall</w> after the policy details were leaked.
Investors watched in shock as the tech giant made an unexpected financial <w>pratfall</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A staged, deliberate fall or trip onto the buttocks, especially as part of comedic physical performance.

examples.text: The motivational speaker started with a <w>pratfall</w> so he could speak about the importance of getting back up.
The clown delighted the audience by taking a comical <w>pratfall</w> across the stage.

senses.sense_definition: An accidental fall onto one's buttocks or backside.

examples.text: He slipped on the icy driveway and took a painful <w>pratfall</w>.
She barely avoided an embarrassing <w>pratfall</w> after catching her heel on the carpet.

senses.sense_definition: To fall onto the buttocks, either accidentally or as a deliberate stunt.

examples.text: The actor had to <w>pratfall</w> repeatedly during rehearsals until the slapstick routine looked convincing.
He lost his balance on the wet pavement and threatened to <w>pratfall</w> in front of the crowd.
